observations: Photo 0: Side view of a black Xbox console with visible scratches and wear on the front panel. The 'XBOX' logo is visible on the lower front. The console has a ribbed vent on the top half.
Photo 1: Front view of the console, showing the same black finish with scratches. The 'XBOX' logo is visible on the top left corner. The bottom half has a diagonal ribbed vent.

Photo 2: Back view of the console showing a label with 'XBOX ONE CONSOLE' printed on it. The label includes model number 'SN: 22004534' and other specifications. The back panel has a small sticker with a warning symbol. The console appears to be in a room with a fan and other items in the background.

claims.claim: Fairly used Xbox One in very good condition
claims.evidence: Photos show visible scratches and wear, but no functional test or internal inspection is shown. The condition is subjective and not fully verifiable from photos alone.
No screen or interface is shown to verify installed games. The console's screen is not visible in any photo.
No controllers or power pack are shown in any photo. The seller states they are needed, but no proof is provided.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal damage
risks.proof: Video showing the console powering on, booting up, and running a game.

risks.risk: Games may not be installed or may be corrupted
risks.proof: Screenshot or video of the console's dashboard showing the 5 games installed.

risks.risk: Controllers and power pack may be missing or damaged
risks.proof: Photos of the controllers and power pack, showing they are present and functional.

risks.risk: Console may have hardware issues (e.g., disc drive, HDMI port, cooling system)
risks.proof: Close-up video of the disc drive spinning, HDMI port connection, and cooling vents.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and running a game.
Screenshot or video of the 5 games installed on the console.
Photos of the controllers and power pack.
Close-up video of the disc drive, HDMI port, and cooling vents.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
